facts.business: Arkade Developers Limited is a Mumbai-based real estate developer focused on residential and commercial projects in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR), operating an execution-led, asset-light model with a portfolio spanning greenfield developments and redevelopment projects.

capacity_or_capex.item: Acquisition of Filmistan Private Limited (100% shares)
Land acquisition at Thane (6.28 acres freehold land parcel)
Capital work-in-progress (Experience centre at Project Evoke)

auditor.name: M/s Amit T. Jain & Co., Chartered Accountants (Internal Auditor); M/s Joshi Apte and Associates (Cost Auditor); M/s AVS & Associates (Secretarial Auditor)
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: The Secretarial Auditor's report does not contain any qualification, reservation or adverse remark or disclaimer or modified opinion.

key_risks: Geopolitical tensions and ongoing conflicts weighing on global growth prospects
Tariff-related trade disruptions and volatility in capital flows impacting exports and investor sentiment
Regulatory and tax demands (e.g., GST demand of Rs 1.14 crore and penalty of Rs 11.46 lakh received in April 2026)
Exceptional accounting impacts from restructuring (e.g., Rs 182.17 crore one-time impact from Filmistan demerger)
Dependence on Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR) real estate market cycles
facts.related_party_note: The Company entered into related party transactions with Promoters, Directors or Key Managerial Personnel. None of the transactions were in conflict with the interest of the Company. Details are disclosed in the notes to the Standalone Financial Statements.
